clue.text: Nudist should cover the feminine French back one's studying in the wild

indicators.note: to cover something is to wrap round it, so the nudist's synonym goes outside the next piece

parts.note: a naturist is a nudist

indicators.note: back tells us to read the French article from right to left

parts.note: la is the French feminine form of 'the'

explanation.surface: A nudist who covers up a French woman's back seems a contradiction in terms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nudist' looks like the subject of the sentence but is the outer shell; the definition is the long phrase at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who studies plants and animals in their natural habitat is called by this name.

clue.text: Find way to raise the terrible match attendance

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising a word lifts it so it reads from bottom to top

parts.note: Ivan the Terrible was the sixteenth-century Tsar of Russia
the gate is the number of spectators at a sporting match

explanation.surface: A plea to boost the dreadful crowd at a game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to raise' turns IVAN into NAVI. 'The terrible' looks like a description of the attendance but stands for Ivan, the Russian tsar.
explanation.definitionFit: To navigate is to plot and follow a route, which is finding one's way.

clue.text: Negotiate over one extra's opening in film

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece placed over another comes before it

parts.note: to talk is to negotiate or discuss terms
one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: an opening is the start, so take the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Bargaining before an extra's first appearance in a movie.
explanation.definitionFit: A talkie was an early film with a soundtrack, as opposed to a silent picture.

clue.text: Puzzle that is full of holes

definitions.meaning: a conundrum or brain-teaser to be worked out
a coarse sieve, or something pierced with many holes

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a conundrum and a coarse sieve, or as a verb to perforate thoroughly.

clue.text: It's unfortunately clear to me one's a poor timekeeper

indicators.note: something gone unfortunately has gone wrong, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone admits it is obvious to them that they are always late.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who habitually arrives after the set time keeps poor time.

clue.text: Go and fish where one pays one's way

parts.note: a go is a turn, as in a game
the pike is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: An invitation to take a go and catch a fish somewhere one pays.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnpike is a toll road, where drivers pay a fee to use the route.

clue.text: Thus the Italian's entered tower

indicators.note: the Italian article has gone into the other word, so it sits inside it

parts.note: so means thus, in that way
il is the Italian for 'the'

explanation.surface: So an Italian man has gone into a tower.
explanation.definitionFit: A silo is a tall cylindrical structure for storing grain, in effect a tower.

clue.text: Take away warship on land

parts.note: a sub, short for submarine, is a naval vessel
a tract is an expanse of land

explanation.surface: Remove a warship that has run aground.
explanation.definitionFit: To subtract is to take one number away from another in arithmetic.

clue.text: Large independent cat offers vital bond

I is short for independent, as with a politician
a feline is a cat

explanation.surface: A big, free-spirited cat provides an essential connection.
explanation.definitionFit: A lifeline is a rope or link on which someone's survival depends.

clue.text: Verify detail arranged by Virginia

indicators.note: by means beside, so one piece stands next to the other

parts.note: VA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Checking a detail organised by someone from Virginia.
explanation.definitionFit: To validate something is to confirm or check that it is correct.

clue.text: Irritation of fine to be passed on

parts.note: a rub is a source of irritation, as in 'there's the rub'
taken as written
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: Annoyance at a penalty that must be handed on.
explanation.definitionFit: Qualities that rub off are transferred to someone else through contact.

clue.text: Jam rugby man's put on grill

parts.note: a grid is a grating or gridiron used for grilling

explanation.definitionFit: Gridlock is a traffic jam so severe that no vehicle can move.

clue.text: Penny has a part in limited release

parts.note: a role is a part in a play

explanation.surface: Penny has a small role in a film with a restricted release.
explanation.definitionFit: Parole is conditional early freedom from prison, a release with restrictions.

clue.text: Note it's old currency

clue.text: He ordains eccentric old African

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Welcome teams off and on going to British sporting event

parts.note: a race is a sporting contest

explanation.surface: Greeting teams arriving intermittently at a British competition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off and on' takes the second and fourth letters of TEAMS, giving EM.
explanation.definitionFit: To embrace an idea is to welcome or accept it gladly.

clue.text: Mother and I will have nearly everything that's relevant

parts.note: all means everything

explanation.surface: Mum and I will possess almost everything that matters.
explanation.definitionFit: Evidence that is material is pertinent and significant to the matter at hand.

clue.text: Spruced up gala with reed that grows underwater

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: With carbon on top, black must be scrubbed from lower-storey window

indicators.note: in a down clue, the piece on top comes first

parts.note: C is the chemical symbol for carbon

parts.note: a basement is the storey below ground level
B is the pencil abbreviation for black

explanation.walkthrough: 'must be scrubbed from' removes B from BASEMENT to give ASEMENT.

clue.text: Get to know about the thing seen on the moors

parts.note: to hear of something is to get to know of it
taken as written

explanation.surface: An urge to learn about something found on open moorland.
explanation.definitionFit: Heather is the low purple-flowered shrub that covers moorland.

clue.text: Way paper presents moving trial

parts.note: a road is a way or route
an exam paper is a test

clue.text: Boat in Rio Grande overturned

indicators.note: overturned says the hidden letters are read backwards
in says the letters sit within the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A vessel capsized in a great American river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' signals the hidden run OGRA, which the draft left without its indicator; 'overturned' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: The Argo was the ship sailed by Jason and the Argonauts in Greek myth.

clue.text: Stop going uphill as well

definitions.meaning: to halt a vehicle at the side of the road
a stretch of road that climbs, a steep incline

parts.note: an and a are the indefinite articles
gin is a spirit

clue.text: Rat appearing in river for a number of years

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Scotland and in Wales

clue.text: Back in the Commons?

clue.text: After lunchtime, two learners will join Sid as he goes round slope

indicators.note: going round means surrounding, so this word encloses the rest

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: after means following, so the learners come after the time

parts.note: one o'clock, written as the Roman numeral I, is a common lunchtime
L is the learner-driver plate, so two learners give two Ls
taken as written

explanation.surface: After lunch two student drivers take Sid around a hill.
explanation.walkthrough: Lunchtime is one o'clock, so I. 'goes round' puts ILLSID inside HE.

clue.text: A shade gloomy

definitions.meaning: a colour, such as that of the sky

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a colour and also means feeling down or melancholy.

clue.text: Change of heart — coach's to drop one near factory

indicators.note: near means next to, so the two pieces sit side by side
dropping something leaves it out, so the numeral is removed

parts.note: to train someone is to coach them
one is the Roman numeral I
a plant is an industrial works

explanation.surface: A trainer decides to sack someone close to the works and has second thoughts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to drop' removes I from TRAINS to give TRANS. 'Change of heart' is not a change of mind but a surgical swap.
explanation.definitionFit: A heart transplant replaces a patient's heart with a donor's, literally changing it.
